import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0135 (a b : ℤ) (h1 : 4 ∣ a^2) (h2 : 4 ∣ b^2) : 4 ∣ (a + b)^2 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0135 (a b : ℤ) (h1 : 4 ∣ a^2) (h2 : 4 ∣ b^2) : 4 ∣ (a + b)^2 := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨l, hk2⟩ := h2
  have : (a + b)^2 = a^2 + 2 * a * b + b^2 := by ring
  rw [this]
  have : 2 * a * b = 0 := by
    rw [mul_zero, zero_mul]
    exact congr_arg (λ x, x + x) (by linarith)
  have : 4 ∣ (a^2 + b^2) := by
    rw [hk1, hk2]
    exact dvd_add_of_dvd_of_dvd 4 4
  exact dvd_add_of_dvd_of_dvd 4 4 this
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0135 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0135 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0135

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0135
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0135
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
